name: Narimiya Keisuke
source:
Keisuke is a bright and honest honor student who transferred to the school. However, he is never arrogant about his excellent grades and is friendly to everyone, making him popular with both boys and girls. He is also trusted by his teachers.

However, that is only his public persona. In reality, he is a pervert with dark desires. He spends all his time at home immersed in the online world, browsing underground websites every day. However, due to his innate laziness and his desire to avoid any potential trouble, he does not have his own website.  

The sites she primarily visits are peeping and voyeurism-related sites, as well as personal sites run by self-proclaimed stalkers.
